This is one of those rare vegetarian gems that prioritizes fresh, homemade dishes over processed alternatives
Apr 2019 • Friends
We visit often, and honestly, we haven’t found anywhere else that truly meets our tastes like this. The location is a hidden gem tucked away by the riverside behind the zoo, it’s incredibly quiet and peaceful. Both the interior and exterior are lovely and kept clean as a whistle.
My friend is a fan of the veggie rotis, while I personally prefer the homemade bagel with spinach & egg; the servings are always plentiful.
Price: Very reasonable for such high quality and value.
Atmosphere: quiet and serene. While the space is intimate, it feels like a sanctuary.
Service: It is rare to see a team so dedicated. They don’t just serve food; they seem to work with a genuine love for humanity. It is an honor to dine here.

Insider tip:
Even if you are not a vegetarian, save this restaurant on your list

Very outstanding salad
Feb 2023 • Friends
As someone who is passionate about the concept of Eating raw. I can say with certainty that Santorino Coffee & Veggies in Ho Chi Minh is a truly exceptional restaurant. From the moment I walked in, I was struck by the unique and innovative approach to food that the restaurant takes.

The "salad not a salad" offerings are truly a standout feature, with a range of dishes that take the traditional idea of a salad and elevate it to new heights. Whether it's a hearty wrap filled with fresh veggies and tangy sauces, or a colorful bowl of mixed greens, grains, and protein, every dish is a true work of culinary art. The flavors are bold, the ingredients are fresh, and the portions are generous.

The restaurant also has a fully vegetarian and vegan menu, so there are plenty of options for those with dietary restrictions.

The atmosphere at Santorino Coffee & Veggies is relaxed and inviting, with a warm and welcoming ambiance. The staff is friendly and knowledgeable, always happy to answer any questions or make recommendations. And with a focus on delivery, it's easy to enjoy this delicious food from the comfort of your own home or office.

In conclusion, I cannot recommend Santorino Coffee & Veggies enough. Whether you're a fan of "salad not a salad" or just looking for a delicious and healthy meal, this restaurant is a must-visit.

My favorite place in Saigon
Dec 2019
Omigosh! This place far exceeded my expectations. The blended iced coconut coffee and the vegan veggie rotis are the most delicious things I’ve had in over a month in Saigon. Woot! 

The coconut coffee is normally made with too much ice in my opinion, diluting the flavor. I order it with “very little ice”, and it comes out perfect. The coffee quality must be high, as it doesn’t give me the jitters like some coffee does. Rotis are so flavorful and hit the spot every time.

This is my happy place in Saigon. Service is genuinely friendly, and the calm, relaxed atmosphere is perfect for getting some work done or just decompressing from the noise and chaos outside. LOVE that they accept credit cards! Secure wifi is nice too. I wouldn’t recommend it for a quick visit – they have a quote on the wall about “good things coming to those who wait”, and they aren’t kidding on either count.

Official hours are Tuesday through Sunday 8:30am-12midnight (closed Mondays), but you could always call or message ahead to make sure they’re open. (On my first visit, I showed up at 7:45 which is when Google maps thinks it opens. I hung out at the café next door for over an hour, and when I wandered over at 9:30, the chef told me they didn’t open until 10:30 but graciously agreed to make me some food. They don’t always open this late, but it seems it happens, and a friend told me they aren’t always open until midnight either.)

Three cheers for Santorino!
